verdict.rationale: The evidence documents general Airwallex APIs (accounts, payouts, card issuing, webhooks) and a built-in Spend AI that fills accounting fields and flags policy issues. Nothing shows an API or MCP endpoint that lets an external agent pull uncoded transactions, propose categorizations or policy flags, and write coding back for review. The in-product AI and the accounting-software sync are adjacent features, not programmatic agent access to expense coding.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull uncoded transactions via API or MCP, propose categorizations and policy flags, and push clean coding back for review
